verdict.rationale: Grafana documents ad-hoc, dynamic exploration ('Explore your data through ad-hoc queries and dynamic drilldown') and provides a documented query language (LogQL) for Loki, plus PromQL-style querying implied via Mimir/Prometheus and Explore mode for logs/metrics/traces. Community feedback confirms real-world use of ad-hoc alert/query flexibility across many datasources, though one comment notes documentation gaps for dashboard/data pulling. Missing for 10: no explicit dedicated 'Explore' feature docs cited beyond GitHub blurb, and no independent hands-on validation specifically of query-language usability beyond community anecdote.
